description: Baseline Capability Ledger — permanent, low-risk capabilities that ship with Foreman. Identical in every consumer repository. Higher-risk capabilities live in knowledge/capabilities.json (standing, per-repo) or .ai/capabilities.json (goal-scoped).

entries.intent: Read repository files and search the codebase
Create and edit files inside the repository (protected paths are covered by deny rules)

Make a pipeline report the failure of any stage, not just its last. Without this the engine cannot write a build command whose exit code is trustworthy: `./gradlew build | tail -20` exits 0 on BUILD FAILED because the status belongs to `tail`, and both standard remedies are refused by the permission matcher unless `set -o pipefail` is itself granted (verified 2026-09-11). The option only ever makes a pipeline stricter - it executes nothing, reads nothing and writes nothing - so it is the rare grant that reduces risk rather than adding it.
entries.scope: the invoking shell, for the duration of one command

entries.intent: Inspect and locally persist git state (checkpoints on the Loop Branch), and read back content from earlier commits — the branch history is the only place a prior run's execution state survives the Cleanup Commit, and `git show <sha>:<path>` is the only way to read it (`git log -p` yields diffs, not file contents); no push, no merge, no history rewriting
